DATED:
 
 IN THE HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD  R/SPECIAL CRIMINAL APPLICATION (FOR CONSENT QUASHING) NO.
 6943 of 2025  ==========================================================
 MOHAMMAD BILAL MOHAMMAD ASLAM GHADIYALI  Versus  STATE OF GUJARAT & ANR.
 ==========================================================
 Appearance:
 A S TIMBALIA(7372) for the Applicant(s) No. 1  MR MANAN MAHETA, APP for the Respondent(s) No. 1  ==========================================================
 CORAM:HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE DIVYESH A. JOSHI  Date : 07/05/2025  ORAL ORDER 1. Rule returnable forthwith.

sentences.text: Mr. Manan Maheta, the learned APP waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the respondent - State of Gujarat.
Mr. Devansh Kakkad, learned advocate waives service of notice of rule for and on behalf of the for the respondent no.2 - original complainant.

2. By this application under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023, the applicant-original accused seek to invoke the inherent powers of this Court praying for quashing of the proceedings of the Criminal Case No.67520 of 2023 pending before the court of learned JMFC,
Surat arising out from the FIR being C.R. No.Part-A-11210005230092 of 2023 registered with Athwalines Police Station, Surat City for the offence punishable under Sections-498A, 323, 504,
506(1), 114 of IPC read with Sections-3 & 5 of the Dowry Prohibition NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/6943/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/05/2025 undefined Act.
3.

sentences.text: 1 4. Mr. A.S. Timbalia, learned advocate appearing for the applicant submits that pursuant to the registration of the FIR, investigation was carried out and ultimately, at the end of day, charge-sheet was submitted before the competent court by the Investigating Officer, which ultimately, culminated into Criminal Case No.67520 of 2023.
As soon as the said fact came to the knowledge of the applicant, he has approached this Hon'ble Court by way of preferring present application.

Learned advocate further submits that during the pendency of present proceedings, the matter has already been settled between the parties and the complainant is not willing to carry out the proceedings further.
The complainant has filed affidavit specifically stating the said fact that if the proceedings of present complaint is quashed, in that event, she has no objection.
An affidavit to that effect has also been filed by the complainant.
It is, therefore, urged that the present application may be allowed.

5. Learned advocate Mr. Devansh Kakkad, for the respondent no.2 - original complainant has submitted that the respondent no.2 - complainant has remained present before this court and she has no objection, if the proceedings qua the present applicant would be quashed.

Learned advocate further submits that the disputes is settled between the parties and an NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/6943/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/05/2025 undefined affidavit in that regard is already filed by the complainant.

Learned advocate has identified the signature of the complainant as well as identified the respondent no.2 - original complainant, who is present before this Court and also confirmed correctness and genuineness of the affidavit filed by her.
6.
Learned APP has submitted that appropriate order may be passed on the strength of the settlement arrived at between the parties.

7. Therefore, since now, the dispute with reference to the impugned FIR is settled and resolved by and between parties, which is confirmed by the original complainant through her learned advocate,
the trial would be futile and any further continuation of proceedings would amount to abuse of process of law.
Therefore, the impugned FIR is required to be quashed and set aside.
The affidavit filed by the respondent no.2- original complainant is ordered to be taken on record.
8. Resultantly, the present application is allowed.

The proceedings of the Criminal Case No.67520 of 2023 pending before the court of learned JMFC, Surat arising out from the FIR being C.R.
No.Part-A-11210005230092 of 2023 registered with Athwalines Police Station, Surat City and all other consequential proceedings arising out of said complaint are hereby quashed and set aside qua the applicant herein.

The Registry shall accept the vakalatnama of Mr. NEUTRAL CITATION R/SCR.A/6943/2025 ORDER DATED: 07/05/2025 undefined Devansh Kakkad, the learned advocate who appeared on behalf of the respondent no.2-original first informant.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
Direct service is permitted.
